messages:
morgan.c: heads-up — we just saw a big eviction spike in ap-southeast1 around 09:05 UTC, looks correlated with a cross-region warm pool scale-up. 40 pods evicted in ~90s.
liam.s: interesting. any node-controller logs or kubelet NotReady events?
morgan.c: yes, grabbing logs now. quick grep showed repeated `failed to get secret from KMS: context deadline exceeded` on the nodes that drained.
raja.k: wait KMS? those are the nodes pulling certs for the private registry right? could be secret fetch latency holding node ready probe.
tess_o: i also see a flurry of taint updates: nodes got `kubelet.k8s.io/unreachable:NoExecute` then a `sched/taint-add` wave from our autoscaler during the burst.
liam.s: autoscaler reacted and tried to drain to rebalance, but because secrets failed, pods couldn't be pulled on new nodes and got immediate evictions — classic bounce.
ops-bot: deploybot: scale event: warm-pool ap-southeast1 increased by 6 nodes at 09:03:12 UTC
morgan.c: snippet from node-controller log:
```
I0309 09:03:15 node_controller.go:423] error syncing node "gke-apse-node-12": failed to update secret handler: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```
liam.s: can you paste the kubelet events from one of the affected nodes?
raja.k: pasted below (short):
- "ImagePullBackOff: Back-off pulling image"
- "Failed to pull image: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded"
- "NodeNotReady: kubelet stopped posting status"
morgan.c: root cause theory: cross-region KMS endpoint had a transient 2s p99 jump — with our kubelet secret fetch timeout set to 1s the nodes failed pulling creds and started tainting.
tess_o: why are we doing KMS calls on node join path synchronously? that seems risky for scale bursts.
aja.k: agreed. fallback plan: make registry pull using node IAM token cached at bootstrap so we don't call KMS on every node join.
liam.s: short-term mitigation: increase kubelet secret fetch timeout + add retry/backoff and delay autoscaler drains for 30s after node becomes Ready.
morgan.c: can we do a quick patch: set secret fetch timeout to 5s in the node bootstrap config and add a 20s delay before the scheduler considers new nodes for eviction/placement?
liam.s: yes, I can cut a canary to staging today. will also add logging to detect `context deadline exceeded` in node join path.
ops-bot: perfmon: cluster cost alert triggered: 09:07 UTC — transient increase in pod churn, estimated +$65 for the minute :grimacing:
cloud-cost-bot: cost-notify: eviction churn added ~0.01 GPU-hours across ap-southeast1 (est. $0.12)
morgan.c: ha, small $$ but riskier is app-level retries and user latency. let's prioritize the timeout/retry patch and postpone aggressive warm-pool drains next time.
raja.k: also suggest adding a health-check to KMS endpoint rtt and gate cross-region scale with a simple probe.
tess_o: opened ticket INFRA-4321 with proposed mitigations and rollout plan. will coordinate with sched and node bootstrap owners.
liam.s: plan: (1) increase secret fetch timeout to 5s (2) add 30s post-ready placement delay (3) add KMS RTT probe and abort scale if >200ms p95. will PR today.
morgan.c: thanks — after PR, let's run a controlled canary: 2-node warm-pool ramp in ap-southeast1 and watch for taints/evicts. tagging oncall.
ops-bot: oncall: @tess_o has been paged for cluster flapping investigation :bell:
liam.s: will follow up in #eng-platform once PR is up. low-risk tweak but should remove this eviction oscillation.
morgan.c: closing loop: after we bumped kubelet timeout on a small test pool, evictions dropped to 0 during a 6-node ramp.
raja.k: nice. still want the KMS probe and a longer-term plan to remove synchronous secret fetch in bootstrap.
tess_o: noted in INFRA-4321. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
